answer.reason: Mareshah was fortified as a city of Judah and was the site of Asa's battle against Zerah the Ethiopian.

clauses.english: was built up as one of the fenced cities of Judah
clauses.quote: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

clauses.english: was where the LORD routed Zerah the Ethiopian's great host before Asa
clauses.quote: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah

doubts: The verses given do not name Rehoboam as the builder of the fenced cities, so the first clause leaves him unnamed.
JOS 15:44 only lists Mareshah among Judah's towns, and MIC 1:15 is a prophecy, so neither is used.
2CH 20:37 names Eliezer of Mareshah, but it concerns his origin, not an event of the place.
